changes.previous_text: Another reviewer initially needed minimum settings and heavy DLSS for an unstable 60 FPS at 1080p on an RTX 3070 and Ryzen 5 5600X, but a later February 2026 edit reports substantial improvement.

changes.text: A review with 6 helpful votes initially reports needing minimum settings and heavy DLSS for an unstable 60 FPS at 1080p on an RTX 3070 and Ryzen 5 5600X, but its later February 2026 edit reports substantial improvement.

changes.previous_text: There are qualifications: one reviewer finds the newer coaster tools useful, and another says the difficult controls become easier with practice.

changes.text: There are qualifications: a review with 36 helpful votes finds the newer coaster tools useful, and a review with 4 helpful votes says the difficult controls become easier with practice.

changes.previous_text: One review describes an arcade-shooter campaign based on collecting samples from dead enemies.

changes.previous_text: One reviewer reports playing mostly with an AI partner and finding that it worked well.

changes.text: The supplied Spacebase DF-9 reviews complain about limited content and depth: a review with 145 helpful votes says its mechanics only sustain a few hours of play, while a review with 1 helpful vote highlights missing management tools and a priority queue.
changes.text_zh: 这些 Spacebase DF-9 评论抱怨内容和深度有限：一条获 145 次有用投票的评论认为，玩法只能支撑数小时；另一条获 1 次有用投票的评论指出，游戏缺少管理工具和任务优先队列。

changes.previous_text: One reviewer says the game freezes whenever they try to launch it after previously playing it.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位评论者表示，曾经玩过一段时间后，游戏现在每次启动都会卡死。
changes.text: A review with 10 helpful votes says the game freezes whenever its author tries to launch it after previously playing it.

changes.text: Reviews also describe glitchy controls and misaligned buildings; however, a review with 14 helpful votes reports no crashes personally while still finding building tools difficult to use.

changes.previous_text: Reviewers praise Silksong's handcrafted art, detailed graphics, and fascinating world design, including a review that otherwise dislikes the game.

changes.text: Reviewers praise Silksong's handcrafted art, detailed graphics, and fascinating world design, including a review with 13 helpful votes that otherwise dislikes the game.

changes.previous_text: One reviewer attributes the lack of opponents to low player numbers, no cross-play, and region restrictions, and reports rarely seeing other players at the time of their review.

changes.text_zh: 一条获 3 次有用投票的评论认为，对手稀少与玩家数量低、没有跨平台联机和地区限制有关，并表示在其发表时很少见到其他玩家。

changes.previous_text: Reviewers praise Hades II's soundtrack as excellent, with one comparing its quality favorably with the first game's music.

changes.previous_text: Umbrella Corps reviewers criticize clunky controls and confusing, chaotic multiplayer; one says the small player population makes it difficult to assemble the four players needed for a match.

changes.previous_text: RollerCoaster Tycoon World reviewers report large-park lag despite good hardware and 20–55 FPS on small parks on a laptop above the recommended specifications.

changes.text: For RollerCoaster Tycoon World, a review with 25 helpful votes reports large-park lag despite good hardware, while a review with 1 helpful vote reports 20–55 FPS on small parks on a laptop above the recommended specifications.
changes.text_zh: 对于 RollerCoaster Tycoon World，一条获 25 次有用投票的评论报告，即使硬件较好，大型公园仍会卡顿；另一条获 1 次有用投票的评论表示，在超过推荐配置的笔记本上运行小型公园时，帧率为 20–55 FPS。

changes.previous_text: A Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown reviewer reports failing to reach 60 FPS on an RX 7900 XT.

changes.text_zh: 一条获 5 次有用投票的 Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown 评论表示，RX 7900 XT 也达不到 60 FPS。

changes.previous_text_zh: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 将回合制战斗与实时招架、闪避结合，因此战斗中仍然需要把握防御时机。

changes.previous_text: Reviewers praise Hades II's gorgeous art style and direction, with one finding the art more beautiful than in the first game.
changes.previous_text_zh: 评论者称赞 Hades II 优美的美术风格与设计，其中一人认为画面比前作更漂亮。
changes.text: Reviewers praise Hades II's gorgeous art style and direction, including a review with 1 helpful vote that finds the art more beautiful than in the first game.
changes.text_zh: 评论者称赞 Hades II 优美的美术风格与设计，其中一条获 1 次有用投票的评论认为，画面比前作更漂亮。

changes.previous_text: The supplied PAYDAY 3 reviews praise its PC optimization and say it runs well, with one attributing particularly good performance to the most recent engine upgrade.

changes.text: The supplied PAYDAY 3 reviews praise its PC optimization and say it runs well, including a review with 153 helpful votes; a review with 2 helpful votes attributes particularly good performance to the most recent engine upgrade.
changes.text_zh: 这些 PAYDAY 3 评论称赞 PC 优化并表示运行良好，其中包括一条获 153 次有用投票的评论；另一条获 2 次有用投票的评论将特别出色的性能归因于其所说的最近一次引擎升级。

changes.previous_text: One reviewer reports smooth 1440p play on a five-year-old PC, while another reports only slight problems at higher settings.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位评论者报告，在使用五年的 PC 上可以流畅运行 1440p；另一位表示，只有在较高设置下出现轻微问题。

changes.text: An Umbrella Corps review with 7 helpful votes says there is no story or lore connecting it to the main Resident Evil storyline.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 7 次有用投票的 Umbrella Corps 评论表示，游戏没有与 Resident Evil 主线相联系的剧情或背景设定。

changes.previous_text: Another expresses interest in more Umbrella lore and side stories rather than describing a substantial existing plot.
changes.previous_text_zh: 另一位希望看到更多 Umbrella 公司的背景与支线故事，而不是在描述当前游戏已有丰富剧情。
changes.text: A review with 3 helpful votes expresses interest in more Umbrella lore and side stories rather than describing a substantial existing plot.
changes.text_zh: 另一条获 3 次有用投票的评论希望看到更多 Umbrella 公司的背景与支线故事，而不是在描述当前游戏已有丰富剧情。

changes.previous_text: Another reviewer praises the graphics and detail.
changes.previous_text_zh: 另一位评论者则称赞画面和细节。
changes.text: A review with 1 helpful vote praises the graphics and detail.
changes.text_zh: 另一条获 1 次有用投票的评论则称赞画面和细节。

changes.previous_text: Reviewers describe its atmospheric effect positively, including one who criticizes the game's difficulty and pacing but still finds the music beautiful.
changes.previous_text_zh: 评论者肯定音乐营造的氛围；即使一位批评游戏难度和节奏的评论者，也认为音乐很美。
changes.text: Reviews describe the music's atmospheric effect positively, including a review with 13 helpful votes that criticizes the game's difficulty and pacing but still finds the music beautiful.
changes.text_zh: 评论肯定音乐营造的氛围；其中一条获 13 次有用投票的评论虽然批评游戏难度和节奏，仍认为音乐很美。

changes.previous_text: The supplied reviews praise Red Dead Redemption 2's writing, characters, and atmosphere for their emotional impact; one reviewer describes being moved to tears and reflecting on the story's themes.
changes.previous_text_zh: 这些评论称赞 Red Dead Redemption 2 的写作、角色和氛围具有情感感染力；一人描述自己感动落泪，并思考故事的主题。
changes.text: The supplied reviews praise Red Dead Redemption 2's writing, characters, and atmosphere for their emotional impact; a review with 1 helpful vote describes being moved to tears and reflecting on the story's themes.
changes.text_zh: 这些评论称赞 Red Dead Redemption 2 的写作、角色和氛围具有情感感染力；一条获 1 次有用投票的评论描述了感动落泪、并思考故事主题的体验。

changes.previous_text: One also reports lag when moving the camera; the reviews do not establish a more specific technical cause.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位还报告移动镜头时卡顿；这些评论没有确定更具体的技术原因。
changes.text: A review with 48 helpful votes also reports lag when moving the camera; the reviews do not establish a more specific technical cause.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 48 次有用投票的评论还报告了移动镜头时卡顿；这些评论没有确定更具体的技术原因。

changes.previous_text: The supplied Redfall reviews criticize graphical bugs, unattractive graphics, and an art style that does not appeal to one reviewer.
changes.previous_text_zh: 这些 Redfall 评论批评图形 Bug、画面难看，以及一位评论者不喜欢的美术风格。
changes.text: Redfall reviews with 493 and 2115 helpful votes criticize graphical bugs and unattractive graphics, respectively; a review with 2 helpful votes also dislikes the art style.
changes.text_zh: 两条分别获 493 和 2115 次有用投票的 Redfall 评论分别批评图形 Bug 和画面难看；另一条获 2 次有用投票的评论也不喜欢它的美术风格。

changes.previous_text: One reviewer also dislikes the reduced randomness of heists compared with PAYDAY 2, despite preferring the newer game's movement and guns.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位还不喜欢劫案随机性比 PAYDAY 2 少，尽管更喜欢新作的移动和枪械。
changes.text: A review with 2 helpful votes also dislikes the reduced randomness of heists compared with PAYDAY 2, despite preferring the newer game's movement and guns.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 2 次有用投票的评论还不喜欢劫案随机性比 PAYDAY 2 少，尽管更喜欢新作的移动和枪械。

changes.previous_text: Some Youngblood reviewers praise solid gunplay and functional mechanics, including more dynamic movement, although one misses dual-wielding two-handed weapons.
changes.previous_text_zh: 部分 Youngblood 评论者称赞射击扎实、机制表现正常，以及更灵活的移动，不过一人怀念双持双手武器。
changes.text: Some Youngblood reviews praise solid gunplay and functional mechanics, including more dynamic movement; a review with 5 helpful votes nevertheless misses dual-wielding two-handed weapons.
changes.text_zh: 部分 Youngblood 评论称赞射击扎实、机制表现正常，以及更灵活的移动；不过，一条获 5 次有用投票的评论仍怀念双持双手武器。

changes.previous_text: A reviewer reports exploits involving unkillable zombies in doorways that block progress, as well as cheating programs that disrupt play.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位报告了利用门口无法被击杀的丧尸堵住进度的漏洞，以及破坏游戏体验的作弊程序。
changes.text: A review with 224 helpful votes reports exploits involving unkillable zombies in doorways that block progress, as well as cheating programs that disrupt play.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 224 次有用投票的评论报告了利用门口无法被击杀的丧尸堵住进度的漏洞，以及破坏游戏体验的作弊程序。

changes.previous_text: Reviewers also report game-breaking bugs, launch freezes, and crashes, including one session becoming broken after 13 hours of play.
changes.previous_text_zh: 评论者还报告了破坏正常游玩的 Bug、启动卡死和崩溃，包括一场游玩 13 小时后崩溃、无法正常继续的经历。
changes.text: Reviews also report game-breaking bugs, launch freezes, and crashes; a review with 5 helpful votes describes a session becoming broken after 13 hours of play.
changes.text_zh: 评论还报告了破坏正常游玩的 Bug、启动卡死和崩溃；其中一条获 5 次有用投票的评论表示，游玩 13 小时后游戏崩溃，无法正常继续。

changes.previous_text: Opinions on Solar Crown's driving differ: some criticize handling, while others enjoy the driving, with one finding the early cars decent and another appreciating how older cars feel different.
changes.previous_text_zh: 对 Solar Crown 驾驶的看法不同：有人批评操控，也有人喜欢驾驶；其中一人觉得早期车辆手感尚可，另一人欣赏老车不同的驾驶感受。
changes.text: Opinions on Solar Crown's driving differ: some criticize handling, while others enjoy the driving; a review with 1 helpful vote finds the early cars decent, and a review with 4 helpful votes appreciates how older cars feel different.
changes.text_zh: 对 Solar Crown 驾驶的看法不同：有评论批评操控，也有评论喜欢驾驶；一条获 1 次有用投票的评论认为早期车辆手感尚可，另一条获 4 次有用投票的评论欣赏老车不同的驾驶感受。

changes.previous_text: One reviewer initially reports unstable 60 FPS at 1080p with minimum settings and heavy DLSS on an RTX 3070 and Ryzen 5 5600X, then describes substantial improvement in a February 2026 edit.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位评论者最初在 RTX 3070 和 Ryzen 5 5600X 上，使用最低设置并较大程度依赖 DLSS，在 1080p 下仍无法稳定达到 60 FPS；随后在 2026 年 2 月的更新中表示性能大幅改善。
changes.text: A review with 6 helpful votes initially reports unstable 60 FPS at 1080p with minimum settings and heavy DLSS on an RTX 3070 and Ryzen 5 5600X, then describes substantial improvement in a February 2026 edit.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 6 次有用投票的评论最初表示，在 RTX 3070 和 Ryzen 5 5600X 上，使用最低设置并较大程度依赖 DLSS，在 1080p 下仍无法稳定达到 60 FPS；随后在 2026 年 2 月的更新中表示性能大幅改善。

changes.previous_text: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 receives praise for emotional storytelling and distinctive combat, though one reviewer finds the story slows in the middle before picking up again.
changes.previous_text_zh: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 因富有情感的叙事和独特战斗受到称赞，不过一位觉得剧情中段变慢、之后才重新精彩。
changes.text: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 receives praise for emotional storytelling and distinctive combat, though a review with 3 helpful votes finds the story slows in the middle before picking up again.
changes.text_zh: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 因富有情感的叙事和独特战斗受到称赞；不过，一条获 3 次有用投票的评论认为，剧情中段变慢，之后才重新精彩。

changes.previous_text: One reviewer praises the story until Act 3 but loses interest afterward.
changes.previous_text_zh: 一位评论者觉得第三幕之前的剧情很棒，但到了第三幕便失去了兴趣。
changes.text: A review with 4 helpful votes praises the story until Act 3 but reports losing interest afterward.
changes.text_zh: 一条获 4 次有用投票的评论认为，第三幕之前的剧情很棒，但到了第三幕便失去了兴趣。

changes.previous_text: Multiplayer experiences vary: some find matches fun, challenging, or enjoyable with friends, while another reports being heavily defeated.
changes.previous_text_zh: 多人体验不同：有人认为对局有趣、有挑战，或适合与朋友游玩，另一位则表示自己被打得很惨。
changes.text: Multiplayer experiences vary: some reviews find matches fun, challenging, or enjoyable with friends, while a review with 13 helpful votes reports its author being heavily defeated.
changes.text_zh: 多人体验不同：有评论认为对局有趣、有挑战，或适合与朋友游玩；另一条获 13 次有用投票的评论则表示，作者自己被打得很惨。

changes.previous_text: Another reports 65–75 FPS at maximum settings without upscaling on their PC, illustrating a different reported experience rather than universal smoothness.
changes.previous_text_zh: 另一位表示自己的 PC 在最高设置、不启用分辨率放大时可达到 65–75 FPS；这反映了不同的个人体验，而不是普遍流畅的结论。
changes.text: A review with 2 helpful votes reports 65–75 FPS at maximum settings without upscaling on its author's PC, illustrating a different reported experience rather than universal smoothness.
changes.text_zh: 另一条获 2 次有用投票的评论表示，作者的 PC 在最高设置、不启用分辨率放大时可达到 65–75 FPS；这反映了不同的个人体验，而不是普遍流畅的结论。

changes.previous_text: Resident Evil Requiem reviewers report smooth PC performance, including 1440p on a five-year-old PC and a separate report above 100 FPS; Left 4 Dead 2 is also praised for broad hardware compatibility and optimization.
changes.previous_text_zh: Resident Evil Requiem 评论者报告 PC 运行流畅，包括五年旧 PC 上的 1440p 体验，以及另一人超过 100 FPS 的报告；Left 4 Dead 2 也因广泛的硬件适应性和优化受到称赞。
changes.text: Two Resident Evil Requiem reviews with 1 helpful vote each report smooth 1440p play on a five-year-old PC and performance above 100 FPS, respectively; Left 4 Dead 2 is also praised for broad hardware compatibility and optimization.
changes.text_zh: 两条各获 1 次有用投票的 Resident Evil Requiem 评论分别报告，在使用五年的 PC 上可以流畅运行 1440p，以及帧率超过 100 FPS；Left 4 Dead 2 也因广泛的硬件适应性和优化受到称赞。

vote_interpretation: Recorded whole-review helpful votes, not additional authors or agreement with each claim.
